links.outcome: Physician performance with versus without AI assistance, compared with autonomous AI
links.effect: Autonomous RareLens and physicians assisted by RareLens both outperformed unaided physicians; effective human-AI collaboration required more than simply providing model outputs.
links.quote: In an external evaluation involving 1,287 cases and 23 physicians, autonomous RareLens and physicians assisted by RareLens both outperformed unaided physicians, while demonstrating that effective human-AI collaboration requires more than simply providing model outputs.

unlisted_practices: Ensembling divergent reasoning from multiple LLMs to reconcile errors across rare disease care stages

screen.reason: Evaluates a multi-LLM alignment system across rare disease care stages and includes a reader study comparing physician diagnostic performance with vs without AI assistance.

primary.practice: AI-assisted clinical decision making vs unaided physician review
